column1: # KaraForge polyphone (破音字) test set, version 1 — frozen 2026-11-21.
# One case per line: a lyric-like phrase in which the character between 【 】 has several
# readings, a tab, and the reading expected there (Hanyu Pinyin with tone number, 5 = neutral).
# How it was built: written by hand (by the assistant that wrote KaraForge) from general
# knowledge of standard Mandarin, BEFORE the reading engine was written, and committed to git
# before any accuracy was measured.  Only cases whose reading is the same under the Taiwan
# (MOE) and the Mainland standard were kept, so the set measures the choice between readings
# and not regional pronunciation.  The expected readings were not checked against an external
# dictionary beyond a test that each one is a known reading of its character.
# Do not edit to make a test pass.  Corrections of genuine mistakes must be listed in
# docs/ruby.md together with the accuracy before and after.
